scope: Controlled same-target local inspection mechanism. Four unseen placements in two authored parent rooms, each with an open shelf lateral sightline and a matched opaque-screen placement. Placements within a parent are dependent. No population-level efficacy claim from this mechanism matrix.
route_trigger: Choose independently from the first complete native candidate pool before or at paid 64 in which at least two distinct legal same-target traces have directly inspectable measured-voxel opportunity areas separated by more than 1e-9 m2. This trigger uses common observed inputs, is independent of the chosen arm and of the calibrated scale, and does not see achieved outcomes. Before and after this single event use the common frozen G_perf policy. If no event qualifies, report the original native trajectory and an unavailable route-effect estimate. Preserve any tie, failure, guard rejection, nonarrival, or same-route result.

direct.same_category_observation: D uses the same visible ideal category IDs 2/3 to identify actually observed support, with a shared measured-only scoring equation for both categories. It does not derive a structural posterior, hidden surface or aperture from the class. The visible support is voxel-deduplicated and weighted by the maximum marginal opportunity seen along the already generated route.
direct.formula: a=.15^2 times sum over observed voxels of the maximum over eligible route views of max(previously unseen azimuth * angular sector deficit * bounded prospective range/incidence quality, positive quality improvement over measured best). Known occupied measured geometry may occlude. Used area is only a ranking proxy.
direct.calibration_scene: dev-only archived paired_cycle_20 S initial same-target opportunity
direct.calibration_rule: Choose the smallest scale whose independently scored direct policy chooses a route different from frozen G_perf on the fixed development state. If none do, keep scale 1. All alternatives and failure/tie are preserved. No heldout outcomes or development surface measurements are used for calibration.

reference: Published independent 5 cm native-to-source sample match. Measure gross new, loss of already represented reference points and net new at fixed paid 96 and actual terminal, each relative to the exact fused common fork. Primary group is the open shelf 31, secondary includes closed cabinet and whole-scene J. Check the same early exclusive samples at the terminal. Do not impute a missed time point. The evaluator-only nominated lateral pose verifies physical view condition but never conditions actor selection.
fidelity: Reuse unchanged candidate admission, same target row and heading, current guard, remaining budget and protected return. No route forced, no extractor lookahead. Actor only reads observed RGB-D, projected laser and ideal visible labels. Source meshes remain inside simulator, and analytic/evaluator geometry reads no actor data during preparation. Optional best executed candidate is limited to the autonomously executed set; no universal oracle conclusion. No real-car result. Complete all predeclared placements even when no comparisons are usable.
